semantics.ready1010MeansNoKnownT1SpecificCorrectiv: READY_10_10 in this file means the T1 reality/quality audit found no remaining feature-specific corrective. It does not mark T2-T9 evidence VERIFIED.

VISIBLE_STATEFUL.productUtilityAssessment: KEEP: user-facing stateful workflow provides current product value and remains justified when backed by canonical state owners.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.correctnessAssessment: Current behavior must project/mutate canonical state, validate inputs and preserve truthful loading/empty/degraded/error states; no independent data acquisition is justified at the surface.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.architectureAssessment: Reuse canonical application, data, identity and persistence owners; surface code is projection/orchestration only.

intelligenceAssessment.rationale: The surface itself should not become an independent learning/decision owner; intelligent behavior belongs to canonical engine responsibilities.

VISIBLE_STATEFUL.dataTruthAssessment: Applicable visible evidence must preserve provenance/freshness/degraded truth; surface-only controls must not manufacture market truth.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.maintainabilityAssessment: KEEP with bounded extraction/refactor when ownership is obscured; no style-only rewrite.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.staleCodeAssessment: No unexplained duplicate current surface owner is permitted; compatibility code requires reachability/equivalence evidence.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.securityRightsAssessment: Role/capability/direct-route parity is required for privileged controls; otherwise normal authenticated access rules apply.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.persistenceLifecycleAssessment: Durable mutation must use canonical state/persistence owners and restore correctly after restart where applicable.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.performanceEfficiencyAssessment: Rendering and mutation must remain bounded under realistic state volume and background activity.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.observabilityAssessment: Visible failures must remain distinguishable from healthy/empty state and must not create app-global false health.

VISIBLE_READONLY.productUtilityAssessment: KEEP: read-only projection is justified when it materially improves decision support, trust, navigation or diagnostics without duplicating canonical acquisition/state.
VISIBLE_READONLY.correctnessAssessment: Projection must reflect canonical current state and preserve missing/stale/partial/contradictory evidence truth.
VISIBLE_READONLY.architectureAssessment: Read-only UI must remain a projection of canonical owners, not a parallel state/data subsystem.

intelligenceAssessment.rationale: Read-only presentation is not itself a learning authority; intelligence belongs to the evidence/state owner it presents.

VISIBLE_READONLY.dataTruthAssessment: Required: unknown/unavailable/stale/partial evidence remains explicit and is never rendered as healthy zero or fabricated certainty.
VISIBLE_READONLY.maintainabilityAssessment: KEEP; extract oversized presentation ownership when it materially improves truth/ownership, with regression protection.
VISIBLE_READONLY.staleCodeAssessment: No duplicate visible evidence home may remain current; intentional redirects/compatibility paths must be named and bounded.
VISIBLE_READONLY.securityRightsAssessment: Restricted diagnostics/evidence must be capability/provider-rights filtered; otherwise authenticated projection only.
VISIBLE_READONLY.persistenceLifecycleAssessment: No independent persistence; restored canonical state must render correctly where applicable.
VISIBLE_READONLY.performanceEfficiencyAssessment: Large-state refresh/render cadence must remain bounded and responsive.
VISIBLE_READONLY.observabilityAssessment: Loading/degraded/unavailable state must be explicit enough to diagnose projection versus source failure.

DATA_PATH.productUtilityAssessment: KEEP when the data path supplies distinct required evidence, authority, recovery or context to current consumers; redundant acquisition is not justified.
DATA_PATH.correctnessAssessment: Schema/normalization/routing/authority/freshness rules must remain deterministic and truthful under missing, stale, contradictory, timeout and fallback conditions.
DATA_PATH.architectureAssessment: Reuse Smart Provider Router v2 and canonical freshness/cache/reconciliation/persistence/subscription owners where applicable; direct authorities remain explicit exceptions rather than hidden routers.

intelligenceAssessment.rationale: Provider/data truth and authority boundaries should remain deterministic by default. Adaptive ranking is permitted only in explicitly named policy owners.

DATA_PATH.dataTruthAssessment: Required: provenance, evidence time, provider lifecycle, direct authority, fallback and degraded states remain distinguishable.
DATA_PATH.maintainabilityAssessment: KEEP one owner per acquisition/normalization responsibility; remove/merge only with consumer and equivalence proof.
DATA_PATH.staleCodeAssessment: No second router, cache, freshness, reconciliation or feature-specific fallback subsystem may survive unexplained.
DATA_PATH.securityRightsAssessment: Provider entitlement/data-rights/secrets/egress rules apply where the capability or projection is restricted.
DATA_PATH.persistenceLifecycleAssessment: Cache/durable evidence may persist only through canonical cache/persistence owners; live/transient data must not silently become durable authority.
DATA_PATH.performanceEfficiencyAssessment: Requests/fan-out must be bounded, coalesced/cache-aware and rate-limit/backpressure aware.
DATA_PATH.observabilityAssessment: Provider/source/freshness/failure/recovery distinctions must be diagnosable without changing routing truth by telemetry alone.

BACKGROUND_JOB.productUtilityAssessment: KEEP only when the job performs distinct scheduled/event-driven work that cannot be safely derived on demand and does not duplicate another cadence owner.
BACKGROUND_JOB.correctnessAssessment: Cadence/window/idempotency/cancellation/manual-trigger behavior must delegate to canonical data/state owners and remain truthful when prerequisites/providers are unavailable.
BACKGROUND_JOB.architectureAssessment: One runtime scheduler plus named coordinator/domain owners; no feature-specific polling architecture or duplicate broad refetch.

intelligenceAssessment.rationale: Session/event/materiality-aware cadence is useful; hidden self-modifying schedules are not. Explicit adaptive-policy owners may override this default.

BACKGROUND_JOB.dataTruthAssessment: Jobs must not extend timestamps or reuse stale prerequisites to fabricate successful current work.
BACKGROUND_JOB.maintainabilityAssessment: KEEP distinct jobs with bounded cadence and shared scheduler ownership; merge only if lifecycle/evidence semantics are truly identical.
BACKGROUND_JOB.staleCodeAssessment: Every active job needs a current consumer/cadence reason; historical loops without current consumers are closure debt.
BACKGROUND_JOB.securityRightsAssessment: Manual triggers and restricted provider work must preserve role/provider-rights checks.
BACKGROUND_JOB.persistenceLifecycleAssessment: Durable checkpoints/state use canonical persistence; restart may not duplicate semantic work.
BACKGROUND_JOB.performanceEfficiencyAssessment: Background work yields to protected market-session priorities, respects backpressure, and remains bounded.
BACKGROUND_JOB.observabilityAssessment: Expected idle, running, skipped/deferred and failed states must be distinguishable where operationally relevant.

SECURITY_STATEFUL.productUtilityAssessment: KEEP: identity/session/authorization/rights responsibilities are necessary product safety boundaries and should remain explicit rather than hidden in convenience code.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.correctnessAssessment: Authorization, hierarchy, session/reauth, input validation, revocation and isolation must fail closed and be consistent across UI/direct route/API.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.architectureAssessment: Exactly one identity/session/authorization owner; UI visibility never substitutes for server-side enforcement.

intelligenceAssessment.rationale: Security/rights decisions must stay deterministic, reviewable and fail closed; adaptive authorization is inappropriate.

SECURITY_STATEFUL.dataTruthAssessment: Security/status projections must not imply authorization/health that the canonical security state does not grant.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.maintainabilityAssessment: KEEP explicit bounded security owners; avoid duplicated role matrices or ad-hoc route checks.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.staleCodeAssessment: Legacy authorization branches or UI-only security paths are blocking if they can diverge from canonical enforcement.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.securityRightsAssessment: Primary dimension: role/capability hierarchy, direct-route parity, recent auth, secret redaction, provider rights and per-user isolation must be explicit.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.persistenceLifecycleAssessment: Identity/session/workspace durable state must restore without plaintext credentials or cross-user leakage.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.performanceEfficiencyAssessment: Concurrent sessions/admin mutations must remain bounded and race-safe; security may not be bypassed for performance.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.observabilityAssessment: Denied/expired/revoked/malformed states must be diagnosable without exposing secrets or sensitive internals.

RUNTIME_STATEFUL.productUtilityAssessment: KEEP when runtime state/lifecycle/load/recovery work preserves reliable current decision support and replaces rather than duplicates ad-hoc loops.
RUNTIME_STATEFUL.correctnessAssessment: Lifecycle, load, degradation, cancellation, recovery and hysteresis must preserve canonical state and never fabricate healthy evidence.
RUNTIME_STATEFUL.architectureAssessment: Reuse one lifecycle/scheduler/workload/degradation/subscription owner set; feature loops must delegate rather than fork runtime control.

intelligenceAssessment.rationale: Runtime should react to session/load/provider context; adaptive behavior must be explicitly bounded in named policy owners.

RUNTIME_STATEFUL.dataTruthAssessment: Runtime pressure/recovery cannot upgrade stale/missing evidence to healthy state or hide scoped degradation.
RUNTIME_STATEFUL.maintainabilityAssessment: KEEP with explicit concurrency/lifecycle ownership and bounded extraction where monolithic coupling creates concrete risk.
RUNTIME_STATEFUL.staleCodeAssessment: Duplicate lifecycle/recovery/load loops are not allowed; old paths need reachability/equivalence proof before removal.
RUNTIME_STATEFUL.securityRightsAssessment: Privileged runtime controls and provider secret/rights boundaries remain enforced.
RUNTIME_STATEFUL.persistenceLifecycleAssessment: Shutdown/restart flushes/checkpoints only through canonical state/cache/persistence owners and may not fabricate warm state.
RUNTIME_STATEFUL.performanceEfficiencyAssessment: Primary dimension: bounded goroutines/queues/locks/fan-out, protected-session priority, load shedding and backpressure.
RUNTIME_STATEFUL.observabilityAssessment: Pressure/degradation/recovery/cancellation states must be scoped and diagnosable.

PERSISTENCE.productUtilityAssessment: KEEP: durable state/restart/upgrade continuity is required for native product reliability; future backend seams are not themselves current product features unless shipped.
PERSISTENCE.correctnessAssessment: Serialization/schema/migration/atomicity/integrity/restore behavior must preserve canonical records and fail visibly on corrupt/interrupted/unavailable state.
PERSISTENCE.architectureAssessment: One persistence manager/backend contract; feature-specific stores extend it without creating parallel persistence systems.

intelligenceAssessment.rationale: Persistence, migrations and recovery must be deterministic and auditable.

PERSISTENCE.dataTruthAssessment: Persisted timestamps/provenance/state must not upgrade stale/transient evidence or conflate cache with durable authority.
PERSISTENCE.maintainabilityAssessment: KEEP backend capability separation; future backend source must be explicitly scoped so it cannot masquerade as shipped behavior.
PERSISTENCE.staleCodeAssessment: Backend variants are justified only by supported platform/build contracts or explicit future-program carry-forward.
PERSISTENCE.securityRightsAssessment: User/identity/workspace/secrets isolation and storage boundaries must prevent cross-user/plaintext leakage.
PERSISTENCE.persistenceLifecycleAssessment: Primary dimension: save/load/migration/integrity/backup/restore/restart/upgrade behavior is explicit and test-owned.
PERSISTENCE.performanceEfficiencyAssessment: Concurrent reads/writes, pools/locks and archive work remain bounded; correctness outranks throughput shortcuts.
PERSISTENCE.observabilityAssessment: Backend readiness/integrity/operation failures must remain distinguishable from empty healthy state.

BOUNDARY.productUtilityAssessment: KEEP: permanent scope/authority/lifecycle boundaries prevent product drift and unsafe or misleading capability expansion.
BOUNDARY.correctnessAssessment: Allowed behavior remains available while forbidden behavior is absent/fail-closed across direct route, fallback, pressure and packaged runtime.
BOUNDARY.architectureAssessment: Boundary rules constrain canonical owners; they do not create parallel feature implementations.

intelligenceAssessment.rationale: Permanent scope/authority/security boundaries must not self-modify or be rank-swapped by learning.

BOUNDARY.dataTruthAssessment: Authority/context/alternative-evidence distinctions remain explicit and cannot be blurred by fallback or UI wording.
BOUNDARY.maintainabilityAssessment: KEEP concise boundary assertions near relevant owners plus durable regression checks.
BOUNDARY.staleCodeAssessment: Any legacy path bypassing the boundary is blocking; harmless compatibility code still needs explicit proof.
BOUNDARY.securityRightsAssessment: Boundary bypass through role/provider rights/fallback is prohibited.
BOUNDARY.persistenceLifecycleAssessment: Boundary remains conserved across restart/migration where durable state participates.
BOUNDARY.observabilityAssessment: Denied/gated/unsupported states must be distinguishable from provider/runtime failure where relevant.

RELEASE.productUtilityAssessment: KEEP: exact-head CI, package/platform and provenance responsibilities are necessary to prove the source tested is the source delivered.
RELEASE.correctnessAssessment: Head identity, workflow topology, package provenance, no-rebuild publication and platform lifecycle must fail closed on divergence/missing evidence.
RELEASE.architectureAssessment: One canonical Fast/Qualified/release workflow family; no shadow release or duplicate expensive gate path.

intelligenceAssessment.rationale: Release/provenance decisions must remain deterministic and reproducible.

RELEASE.dataTruthAssessment: Release/version/source labels must match exact Git objects and immutable evidence; stale checkpoints cannot redefine Stable.
RELEASE.maintainabilityAssessment: KEEP conserved efficient gates; simplify only when equivalent evidence is preserved.
RELEASE.staleCodeAssessment: Retired workflows/tests may remain only as explicit equivalence sentinels; no active duplicate publication path.
RELEASE.securityRightsAssessment: Tokens/secrets/artifacts/publication permissions remain least-privilege and non-leaking.
RELEASE.persistenceLifecycleAssessment: Install/upgrade/rollback/profile preservation is required where packaged runtime state participates.
RELEASE.performanceEfficiencyAssessment: CI conservation avoids redundant expensive work without weakening exact-head evidence.
RELEASE.observabilityAssessment: Candidate/head/artifact/run identity and failure stage must be reconstructable from GitHub evidence.

SURF-DOCUMENTATION.maintainabilityAssessment: Dedicated documentation architecture owner is the target; remaining legacy monolith fallback may stay only as explicitly non-canonical compatibility until reachability/equivalence-backed cleanup.
improvementOpportunities: qualify dedicated documentation architecture owner and stale-wording regression

SURF-ADMINISTRATION.architectureAssessment: Administration must be a capability-scoped surface that reuses canonical identity/session/admin APIs; embedding it inside Settings was an IA mismatch, not a reason for a new security backend.
SURF-ADMINISTRATION.maintainabilityAssessment: Dedicated surface ownership reduces Settings coupling while preserving one identity/session authority.
improvementOpportunities: qualify dedicated authorized Administration destination and Settings separation

SURF-MARKET-INTELLIGENCE.maintainabilityAssessment: Current unknown classification behavior is truthful, but a hard-coded sector/industry classification table is a maintainability limitation if coverage grows.
improvementOpportunities: Future governed evidence-derived sector/industry classification can replace hard-coded coverage while preserving unknown-as-unknown truth.

LEGACY-EVIDENCE-ROUTES.architectureAssessment: Legacy News/Earnings/Filings destinations are intentional compatibility redirects into canonical Market Intelligence/Research, not current evidence owners.
LEGACY-EVIDENCE-ROUTES.staleCodeAssessment: Redirect compatibility remains justified. Old monolith standalone render implementations are cleanup candidates only after reachability/equivalence proof.
improvementOpportunities: Remove unreachable legacy render implementations only after navigation/reachability/equivalence evidence proves compatibility is preserved.
LEGACY-EVIDENCE-ROUTES.deferredImprovementOwner: #120 IA evidence plus #123 durable regression ownership

intelligenceAssessment.rationale: Bounded candidate detection/promotion reacts to current market/session evidence and reuses shared acquisition without altering protected deterministic desk formulas.
Production move detection is deterministic/context-aware; outcome learning remains SHADOW and cannot auto-promote or rewrite protected rules.
AI is a bounded evidence-grounded second opinion over canonical packages, not market-data truth, authorization, routing or execution authority.
Capability quality/rate-limit evidence may affect bounded ranking/avoidance while explicit provider lifecycle remains governed and cannot auto-promote.
Durable agreement/conflict/single-source usefulness evidence is advisory-only today and cannot directly change routing without a separately governed policy.
Durable evidence/decision/outcome lineage is the correct bounded learning foundation and does not create an execution journal.
Outcome recording supports validation/learning while protected decision and No Execution boundaries remain deterministic.
Cadence/utility adjustments are the appropriate adaptive layer when bounded, explainable, reversible and subordinate to canonical data/routing owners.
Temporal prep orchestration should react to session/catalyst context but not become a learning or acquisition authority.
Bounded load shedding/reserved capacity should adapt to current pressure while preserving Tier-0/protected priorities and deterministic safety limits.
